name: COMA-BERENICES-M dwarf candidate (Hubble)
blurb: COMA-BERENICES-M, a candidate ultra-faint dwarf galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: comaberenicesm-hubble
story: Hubble looked here to confirm a possible ultra-faint dwarf galaxy, one of the smallest kinds of galaxy known. If confirmed, it would lie on the edge of the Local Group, beyond the reach of both the Milky Way and Andromeda.

claims.text: COMA-BERENICES-M is one of six ultra-faint dwarf candidates Hubble program 17759 aims to confirm
The target is cataloged as a dwarf spheroidal galaxy
The candidates appear to lie beyond the virial radius of the Milky Way and M31, toward the edge of the Local Group
The smallest galaxies matter for understanding structure formation
